text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help you build a solid working understanding of Python, ChatGPT, and web scraping.

I have 6 years of experience with Python, machine learning, NLP, LangChain, OpenAI API, and related tools. Recently, I built a call centre speech analytics pipeline that transcribes calls, separates agent and customer, and writes a QA summary for every call, with QA coverage increasing from 3% to 100% of calls. I also built a contract clause search assistant that answers questions over 9,000 contracts and always quotes the clause and page it used, reducing clause lookup from 25 minutes to 3 minutes.

For your project, I can walk you through how to use ChatGPT with Python, explain scraping fundamentals, and help you start building scripts for larger websites and database ingestion. I’d be happy to do this in a Zoom tutoring session.
